name: Parent Notice of Scheduled Examinations and Screenings
description: Notice of upcoming physical/dental examinations or screenings with date and location, invitation to attend, the private-exam option, and possible religious exemption.
deadline: before each scheduled examination or screening
quote: Parents/Guardians of students who are to receive physical and/or dental examinations or screenings shall be notified. The notice shall include the date and location of the examination or screening and notice that the parent/ guardian is encouraged to attend or may have the examination or screening conducted privately at the parent's/guardian's expense.
